title: Check what's underneath
lines: Everyone looks up, at the branch or the wall.
But the biggest danger waits under the wheels.
Solid-looking ground can hide a pit or a pipe.
Check manholes, soft soil and parking-garage roofs.
And put pads under the outriggers.
Stability up top starts with the ground below.
Tal's daily tip. Ofek At Tal Cranes.
